description.value: The Little Donkey is a Mexican-fusion burrito and craft beer restaurant with its original location in the historic Fort Langley village, a hub for cycling in the Fraser Valley. Fresh burritos are made daily from inventive recipes — Spanish brisket, Greek chicken, pulled pork, and several vegetarian and vegan builds — paired with locally curated beers and ciders on tap. The compact, patio-equipped spot has a community feel and also offers catering and private events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Fort Langley location with a phone number matching OSM (+1-604-371-4775 / (604) 371-4775), and the website address (#125, 9220 Glover Road) clearly differs from the OSM street tag (Mavis Avenue), so the website address is used and the discrepancy flagged. Takeout is confirmed by online order links, DoorDash, and UberEats on the website; vegetarian/vegan and GF options are explicitly labelled in the menu. Bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, and other cycling-specific amenities are not mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists addr:street=Mavis Avenue (no house number) but the website clearly states the Fort Langley location is at #125, 9220 Glover Road, Langley, BC V1M 2S1. Website address used as it is more specific and current; OSM record may need correction.
Bike parking (a required WWC criterion) is unconfirmed — neither the website nor OSM tags mention a rack or approved parking area. On-site verification recommended before publishing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active food-and-drink business in Fort Langley with confirmed takeout, multiple vegetarian/vegan/GF menu options, and customer washrooms — a well-suited mid-ride stop in a heavily cycled Fraser Valley corridor. Bike parking should be verified on-site before publishing.
